title.narrative: Himachal Pradesh Clean Energy Transmission Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative:
The Project proposed for financing under the requested PFR consists of:
1. New Transmission System Assets
A. Transmission Line Construction i. 66 kV D/C Line from 66 kV Switching station at Urni to Wangtoo Sub station. ii. 220 kV Line from 33/220 kV Lahal sub station up to 220 kV Yard of Budhil HEP. iii. 220 kV D/C (Twin MOOSE) Transmission Line from Sunda to Hatkoti. iv. 132 kV D/C (PANTHER) Transmission Line from Kangra to Dehra. v. 220 kV D/C line (Twin MOOSE) from Charor to 400/220 kV Banala sub station of PGCIL.
B. Construction of Sub Stations i. 66 kV Switching station at Urni. ii. 33/220/400 kV, 50/63 MVA P.S at Lahal. iii. 132/220 kV, 2x100 MVA Pooling Station at Sunda. iv. 132/220 kV, 1x80/100 MVA Sub Station at Charor.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved capacity of HPPTCL to transmit electricity from hydropower generation sources within and outside of Himachal Pradesh.

Installed new transmission lines installed totaling 106 km (Baseline = 0) Progress/Status: Three Transmission line about 67.12 circuit-kilometer (49.54 km) has been commissioned. Spillover works of two transmission line about 77.57 circuit-kilometer (38.79 km) has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

620.5 MVA of additional substation capacity from 6 new substations (Baseline = 2,338 MVA existing capacity) Progress/Status: 693.5 MVA of additional substation capacity from one substation and 45 MW of additional capacity pooled at switching station has been achieved. Spillover work of two substation (300 MVA) has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of HPPTCL personnel on project management, and transmission utility operations improved. Indicator: Training program of about 50 HPPTCL staff participants by 2017 completed. Progress/Status: Complied. Data Source: Training reports HPPTCL reports
Actual value:

Indicator: All HPPTCL technical staff undergo ERP and related IT training by 2019. Progress/Status: Complied. Data Source: HPPTCL reports Actual value:

Output: Enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, phase II and additional IT hardware installed in HPPTCL corporate facilities and are operational. Indicator: ERP system installed at HPPTCL offices by 2019. Progress/Status: Complied. Data Source: ERP Implementation consultant reports Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 132/220 kV, 1x80/100 MVA GIS substation at Charor by December 2019. Progress/Status: Works of 132/220 kV, 1X80/100 MVA GIS Charor substation (27-SS) has 46% completed and spillover works of this subproject has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 132/220 kV, 2x100 MVA GIS P.S. at Sunda by December 2019. Progress/Status: Works of 132/220 kV, 2X100 MVA GIS Sunda Pooling station (28-SS) has 66% completed and spillover works of this subproject has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 220 kV D/C Transmission Line from Sunda to Hatkoti by December 2019. Progress/Status: Work of 220 kV double-circuit line from Sunda to Hatkoti (15-TL) is 95% completed and spillover works of this line has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 220 kV D/C line from Charor to 400/220 kV Banala substation of PGCIL by December 2019. Progress/Status: 220 kV double-circuit line from Charor to 400/220 kV Banala substation of PGCIL (12-TL) has been commissioned. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 220 kV S/C line on D/C towers from 33/220 kV Lahal substation up to 220 kV Yard of Budhil HEP by December 2019. Progress/Status: 220 kV single-circuit line on double-circuit tower from 33/220 kV Lahal substation to 220 kV yard of Budhil HEP (11-TL) has been commissioned. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 33/132, 2x25/31.5 MVA GIS substation at Chambi (Shahpur) with LILO point of 132 kV Kangra-Dehra S/C Line by December 2019. Progress/Status: 132 kV single-circuit line from LILO point of Kangra to Dehra (20-TL) has been commissioned. 33/132, 2X25/31.5 MVA GIS Chambi (Shahpur) substation has been shifted to Tranche 1. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 33/220 kV, 50/63 MVA GIS Pooling Station (P.S.) at Lahal by December 2019. Progress/Status: 33/220/400 kV, 315*2 MVA + 50/63 MVA GIS Pooling Station at Lahal (9-SS) has been commissioned. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:

Output: New Transmission system assets are operational. Indicator: Commissioning of 66 kV D/C Line from 66 kV switching station at Urni to Wangtoo substation by December 2019. Progress/Status: Work of 66 kV double-circuit transmission line from 66 kV switching station Urni to Wangtoo (10-TL) is 84% completed and spillover works of this line has been shifted from Tranche 2 to Tranche 3. Data Source: HPPTCL annual reports. Actual value:
